resources.string: Record all VoIP apps (not just WhatsApp)
Hide notification (no permanent notification; needs Notification access)
Grant Notification access so recording can run without a permanent notification
● Active — allow-listed VoIP calls will be recorded to /sdcard/CallRecordings
Off — no calls are being recorded
Recorder failed to start — check permissions / logcat

Records both sides of VoIP calls from WhatsApp (and, optionally, other calling apps) and saves them as WAV files in the CallRecordings folder.

Recording a call may require the consent of everyone on the call. Laws differ by country and some places require all parties to agree. You are responsible for using this legally and for informing the other party. A notification is shown while any call is being recorded.

Only your mic (uplink) and the other party (downlink) are captured; nothing is uploaded anywhere.
